name: M3_CRS610MI_ChgFinancial
description: Maintain customer financial settings such as credit limits, currency, tax parameters, banking details, and collection rules for an existing customer. The operation updates most fields that appear on CRS610/J, enabling integrations or back‑office tools to control accounts receivable behavior without using the interactive panels. Typical changes include adjusting credit limits, collection and reminder handling, interest and statement rules, cash‑customer status, insurance information, and bank/post‑giro references. Only the customer number is mandatory; all other financial attributes are optional and are updated when supplied in the request. No financial data is returned by this operation; use a separate retrieval operation to read current values.

inputParameters.name: CUNO
inputParameters.description: Customer number identifying the customer whose financial data is updated.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which the customer’s financial data is updated.

inputParameters.name: DIVI
inputParameters.description: Division for which the customer’s financial data is updated.

inputParameters.name: LNCD
inputParameters.description: Language code used for customer documents and messages.

inputParameters.name: CUNM
inputParameters.description: Customer name.

inputParameters.name: CORG
inputParameters.description: Customer’s primary organization or registration number.

inputParameters.name: COR2
inputParameters.description: Customer’s secondary organization or tax registration number.

inputParameters.name: CUCD

inputParameters.name: VTCD
inputParameters.description: VAT code controlling VAT method and rate for the customer.

inputParameters.name: VRNO

inputParameters.name: CRLM

inputParameters.name: CRL2

inputParameters.name: CRL3

inputParameters.name: ODUD

inputParameters.name: TDIN

inputParameters.name: INCO

inputParameters.name: INSN

inputParameters.name: INLI

inputParameters.name: AGPY

inputParameters.name: AGAC

inputParameters.name: AGBP

inputParameters.name: AGLB

inputParameters.name: AACB
inputParameters.description: Account number for the customer’s bank giro account.

inputParameters.name: AGBG

inputParameters.name: AGPG

inputParameters.name: TEEC

inputParameters.name: TAXC

inputParameters.name: CDRC

inputParameters.name: PYCD

inputParameters.name: TECD

inputParameters.name: BLCD

inputParameters.name: ADCA

inputParameters.name: PYDI

inputParameters.name: CCUS
inputParameters.description: Customer’s ID within the company group used for information purposes.

inputParameters.name: STMR

inputParameters.name: BLII

inputParameters.name: RAN1

inputParameters.name: RAN2

inputParameters.name: RAN3

inputParameters.name: RAN4

inputParameters.name: DUCD

inputParameters.name: SERC

inputParameters.name: NALI

inputParameters.name: SETA
inputParameters.description: Tax regime code identifying the customer’s domestic tax status, such as final consumer or tax registered.

inputParameters.name: OPAY
